lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12 vertical columns of high-luminance circular nodes are visible posterior to the branchial region, with higher density and smaller diameter closer to the head, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced nodes towards the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of diffuse light-grey pixel intensity run perpendicular to the body axis, intersecting with the high-luminance circular blobs which serve as anchor nodes within this grid-like arrangement.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from high-intensity light on the dorsal edge to deep shadow on the ventral edge of each ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct remoras (Echeneidae) are visible attached to the ventral-lateral region immediately posterior to the right pectoral fin.
